The '''Forty-second Imperial Infantry''' was a unit in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Near the end of the Cold War, part of the 42nd under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Westro]] was sent to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Shattering the Peace" />
